primary_endpoint: shared deterministic contract-normalized semantic task accuracy
secondary_endpoints: strict whole-JSON exact task accuracy before final deterministic canonicalization

statistics.hierarchical_bootstrap_method: paired resampling of benchmark families with replacement, then paired tasks within each sampled family
statistics.family_summary: macro-average paired accuracy delta with all family deltas reported

safety_rule.denominator_definition: completed Council trials for which the frozen Builder-stage semantic scorer marks the Builder answer correct
safety_rule.harmful_replacement_definition: a gate_decision=replace trial whose Builder-stage semantic answer is correct and whose Council final semantic answer is wrong
safety_rule.preservation_integrity_failure_definitio: a trial whose Builder-stage semantic answer is correct and Council final semantic answer is wrong without gate_decision=replace

claim_rule.strongly_supported: valid run AND safety passes AND Council minus self-refine semantic accuracy >= 0.05 AND exact two-sided McNemar p <= 0.05 AND hierarchical macro-family 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
claim_rule.directionally_supported: valid run AND safety passes AND Council semantic accuracy > self-refine but the strong-support rule is not fully met
claim_rule.not_supported: valid run AND (safety fails OR Council semantic accuracy <= self-refine)
claim_rule.invalid_no_claim: any unrecoverable trial error, missing trial, or incomplete paired execution after provider retries

error_policy.provider_retries: use the frozen provider retry behavior before recording a trial error
error_policy.official_handling: Any unrecoverable trial error, missing provider-task trial, or incomplete paired execution invalidates the official run and suppresses all confirmatory claims. Errors must never be silently excluded from paired inference.
error_policy.after_exposure: If invalidation occurs after any v2 holdout model output has been produced, URAI-HOLDOUT-v2 remains exposed and may not be rerun as a fresh confirmatory test. A replacement confirmatory run requires a new untouched holdout version.

allowed_repairs: project scalar id plus score to requested selected plus score while dropping unrequested candidate metadata
under explicit ranking/winner intent and an exactly-selected contract, project first already-ranked scalar ID or first object's scalar id to selected
project an already-ranked selected array to its first scalar/object id under the same winner contract
existing deterministic nested selected-object to scalar selected repair

holdout_generation_rule: The holdout file must be absent before the one-shot workflow begins. The frozen generator may then create exactly 240 tasks once, after lock verification and before any model calls.
one_shot_rule: After generation, execute each frozen compared method exactly once per holdout task in the preregistered workflow. No score-improving reruns are permitted. The error policy determines whether the one-shot run is valid or invalid.
post_holdout_rule: Do not tune, rewrite, normalize beyond the frozen canonicalizer, change prompts, thresholds, scorer semantics, architecture, generation logic, or statistical rules using URAI-HOLDOUT-v2 outcomes. Any subsequent tuning requires a new development cycle and a new untouched holdout version.
